articles.summary: Creates brand-led business unit structure – CELSIUS ® , Alani Nu ® and Rockstar ® Energy Emerging Growth – to support the Company’s next stage of growth Appoints Alex Zigliara as President, CELSIUS® and Rishi Daing as President, Rockstar ® Energy Emerging Growth New structure combines dedicated brand leadership with the scale and capabilities of Celsius Holdings’ connected platform Celsius Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CELH) (“Celsius Holdings” or “the Company”) today announced a new brand-led organizational structure in the U.S. and leadership appointments designed to help accelerate growth, sharpen commercial focus and support faster execution across its scaled total energy portfolio.
